background: Intesa Sanpaolo is Italy's largest bank, funded by Italian retail deposits and lending to Italian households and companies, with large wealth management and insurance arms and a smaller international network in Central and Eastern Europe.
synthesis: All three main agencies rate the bank, A- on average with the weakest at BBB+, one on a positive outlook and two on a stable outlook, after a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 25 Nov 2025. Leverage of 5.7% is above the EU and Nordic peer median, but CET1 of 13.0% and LCR of 138% are in the bottom quarter and NSFR of 120% below the median. None of the ratios has moved materially over the past four periods to 30 Jun 2026; the rating is held down by its home sovereign as much as by its own figures.
